title: The Global market for the wool
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：global　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 global 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the baker wrote of ① a global market for the wool in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② so global that nobody in the bakery would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the global ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the global market for the wool that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too global to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the global ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a global problem of the seas, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as global as the problem of the seas they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was global or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something global, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite global; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the global ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, before dawn, she wrote of another global market for the wool in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less global than anybody had expected. ⑩ The global problem of the seas that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the global ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 全球（前置定语 a global market for the wool：1951 年面点师在账单里记下的那件全球的市场）
B. adj. 全球／全面（两处加强说法：so global that … 与 no less global than …）
C. adj. 全球／全面（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 全球（表语 too global to do：母亲觉得它太全球，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 全面（前置定语 a global problem of the seas：叔叔把整件事称作一桩全面的全球性问题）
F. adj. 全面（同级比较 as global as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩海洋的全球性问题相比）
G. adj. 全面（后置定语 something global：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 全面（受程度副词修饰 quite global：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a global market for the wool
the global market for the wool that
a global problem of the seas
The global problem of the seas that

answers.why: global 意为“全球”，1951 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件全球的市场”，此处作前置定语 a global market for the wool。
global 意为“全球”，此处用 so global that 结构，说它全球到糕饼铺里没人敢靠近。
global 意为“全球”，账单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的全球羊毛的全球市场，等于最高级的说法。
global 意为“全球”，母亲认为这件东西“太全球了，谁也用不上”，too global to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
global 意为“全面”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩全面的全球性问题”，此处作前置定语 a global problem of the seas。
global 意为“全面”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩海洋的全球性问题一样全面”，同级比较用 as global as。
global 意为“全面”，账单上那半行字要的是“全面的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something global。
global 意为“全面”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当全面”，quite 修饰原级 global。
global 意为“全面”，no less global than 表示“其全面不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之全面不亚于任何人的预料。
global 意为“全面”，母亲 1963 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的全面全球性问题”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件全球的市场。（a global market for the wool）
它全球到糕饼铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so global that …）
母亲觉得它太全球，谁也用不上。（too global to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩全面的全球性问题。（a global problem of the seas）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩海洋的全球性问题一样全面。（as global as …）
到了 1958 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件全面的东西。（something global）
answers: In 1951 the baker wrote of a global market for the wool in the bill.
It was so global that nobody in the bakery would go near it.
My mother thought it too global to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a global problem of the seas.
He said nobody would call it as global as the problem of the seas they had once had.
By 1958 the bill asked for nothing but something global.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 global 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the baker wrote of a global market for the wool in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the global market for the wool that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too global to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a global problem of the seas, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite global, and everybody laughed.
The global ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
